note: Pure-absorber bound at 0.0253 eV: B10 sigma_s/sigma_a ~ 6e-4, so uncollided transport dominates and the boron component follows exp(-Sigma_t z) with Sigma_t = N_B10*(sigma_a+sigma_s) = 0.2308 cm^-1 at rho=1e-3 g/cm3. The 2% tolerance covers residual single-scatter buildup and mesh discretization; the photon component (0.478 MeV capture gamma) is excluded from the law.
